svg.title: Double-well energy surface
svg.desc: Sketch of an energy surface E over the x-y plane with two wells separated by a central hump. Horizontal level curves at three energies are drawn on the surface: a low level that forms a separate loop in each well, a level just above the hump, and a high level enclosing both wells. Trajectories run around the surface along these level curves. Dotted lines project the low loop in the left well down to a small closed curve on the plane.
